candidates.name: Fishing for Smishing: Labeled Smishing Dataset (IMC '25)
candidates.license_caveats: Requires attribution under CC BY 4.0; no publisher-signed checksum file provided.
candidates.source_population: Public user-submitted smishing reports mined from online reporting forums/social feeds (e.g. Reddit) globally
candidates.collection_method: Programmatic scraping and OCR/text extraction of public smishing report posts with upstream NER PII redaction
candidates.geography_and_period: Global (top non-empty English networks: IND=3,657, USA=1,492, GBR=798, AUS=447, CAN=180; reported period includes 2023+ campaigns)

original_label_taxonomy.scam_type: Categorical attack theme across banking, others, government, delivery, telecom, spam, wrong number, hey mum/dad

candidates.record_id_scheme: CSV 1-based row index (no explicit publisher UUID column)
rejection_or_limitation_reasons: Positive-only dataset (0 genuine legitimate/benign SMS negatives): cannot measure FPR, Specificity, Precision, Tier-2 false blocks, or two-class ROC-AUC.
Pairing 2023+ Presidio-redacted IMC25 positives against 2002-2011 unredacted UCI ham negatives creates fatal domain, era, and placeholder-token confounding.

Heavy upstream NER redaction (<URL> in 6,030/14,362 unique non-spam English rows, <DATE_TIME>, <PHONE_NUMBER>, false <US_DRIVER_LICENSE> tags) strips raw URL domains and callback numbers inspected by SentinelPulse heuristics, breaking verbatim evaluation.

2002-2011 domain/era mismatch vs modern A2P transactional banking, 2FA, Zelle/Venmo, and broken-phone WhatsApp smishing.
